genesis_plus_gx.note: Cartridges need no BIOS. The reader identifies the game only.

md-country.description: Country field at 0x1F0, after a 512-byte copier header is dropped (console name absent at 0x100 and the size an odd multiple of 512). 'EUR', 'JAP', 'USA' (either case, three letters) name one region. Otherwise each of the 4 characters adds bits: U 4, J 1, K 1, E 8, a hex digit its value. The highest-priority bit set wins.
md-country.note: A short list of product codes forces the region of games with a wrong header (loadrom.c:1127-1144).
